steps.text: Take off gently and hold inside the marker. Keep speed below 1 m/s for two seconds.
steps.title: Take off and hold

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 1. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 1

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 2. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 2

steps.text: Follow the next-gate marker through original gate 3. Look ahead and leave room to turn.
steps.title: Pass original gate 3

steps.text: Choose a clear patch of terrain, level the drone and lower throttle gently until grounded for two seconds.
steps.title: Land gently
